## Background

I grew up in a town called Mysore, and studied in PES University, Bangalore. After graduating, I worked in Robert Bosch for 5 years, where I worked on Anomaly Detection, before decided to continue my studies.


## Why data science

I was inspired by projects like Project Euphonia, Project Relate, and Project Lookout. I believe the most meaningful ML problems are the ones that help people communicate, move, and live more independently.

## Outside of data science

I love to travel and explore new places. I like trying new restuarants, and explore new cuisines. I am learning to play Guitar.
